extracted.name: Next level cosmopolitan
extracted.description: Bring a festive twist to the classic cosmopolitan with clementine. The extra sweetness helps balance the citrus notes from the triple sec
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp freshly squeezed clementine juice (or use mandarin orange or satsuma juice)
strip of clementine or orange peel to garnish
instruction_lines: Put a cocktail or coupe glass in the fridge to chill. Meanwhile, pour the vodka, triple sec and fruit juices into a cocktail shaker. Add a large handful of ice, then shake well until the outside of the shaker feels very cold.
Strain the cocktail into the chilled glass. Twist the citrus peel over the drink to express the oils, then drop into the glass to garnish.
